1.name: Ana

fixed.text:
Name: Ana Reed, 34, Female, body type Thin.
Childhood: Farm kid. Grew up hauling water and mending fences on a dry-land farm.
Adulthood: Cook. Ran a canteen for miners and learned to read a room by what people ordered.
Traits: Kind (Genuinely cares about others and is slow to anger.); Optimist (Expects things to turn out fine, mostly.)
Skills (* minor passion, ** major passion): Intellectual 8, Cooking 8*, Medicine 6
Ideoligion: The Long Table. Memes: structure (Order keeps people safe.). Precepts: Drugs: prohibited; Rituals: rarely.
Xenotype: Baseliner (Baseliners are normal humans with no engineered genes.)
Joined the colony: Ana arrived with the first group.
Notable moments: Dug the first trench
Appearance: Ana has a weathered face and practical clothes.
Key relatives: Bram (lover), Tam (child)

extras.words: clear and well-spoken, a good vocabulary

voice.register_line: Speaks warm, asks after people, sees a bright side, talks in kitchen terms.
